image_backbone: MobileNetV3-Small (fine-tuned on cluster split, feature dim=576)
synthetic_pairing_strategy: Independent random combinations of single-modality samples stratified by class label. Zero cross-split leakage: Train pairs constructed strictly from Train images and Train CBCs; Test pairs constructed strictly from Test images and Test CBCs. 8% discordance rate with systemic anemia label defined by WHO hemoglobin threshold.
clinical_disclaimer: This model was trained exclusively on artificially combined image and laboratory records. It establishes architectural tensor compatibility and forward/backward gradient learning, but CANNOT be used for clinical decision-making or real-patient diagnostic screening.
